capabilities: insert spaces between CJK and Latin or digit text
format the current note, a selection, or all notes in a folder
skip code blocks, inline code, URLs, links, wikilinks, and HTML tags
extras: README warns to back up notes before batch-formatting a folder. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and installation in the directory is pending approval.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to enforce CJK–Latin spacing rules, which are a common convention in Chinese writing.
summary: Chinese typography formatter that adds spaces between CJK and Latin/digit text and tidies spacing around Chinese punctuation.
